snippet.title: Bacon Escape - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
This little piggy went to market, this little piggy stayed home, this little piggy ESCAPED PRISON AND RAN FOR HIS LIFE!

Available on both AppStore and Google Play  - just follow the links below!
AppStore: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/bacon-escape/id1199364353?mt=8&pt=22316&at=11l5Te&ct=youtube
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=se.illusionlabs.baconescape

From the makers of the “App Store Best of 2016” game Mr. Crab 2, Illusion Labs presents: Bacon Escape.

It’s time to bring home the bacon.

Fleeing your sinister jailors, Bacon Escape is your quest to break free from captivity and join your animal friends. But make sure you’re not guiding your piggy out of the frying pan and into the fire…

You’ll have endless fun exploring amazing landscapes, completing awesome challenges, and emerging victorious as all your friends cheer you on. Simple to play but challenging to master, the whole family will be hooked on Bacon Escape. 

Follow @illusionlabs on Twitter
Like us at www.facebook.com/illusionlabs1
